name: Shiraishi Teppei
source:
A young man who lives in the house of [url=/c123799]Kashiwagi Kyuuzou[/url], [url=/c123786]Narumi[/url]'s mentor. Although he is a delinquent with bad attitude, to his closest buddies he is a friendly and funny character. He speaks in Kansai dialect. Since [url=/c123784]Kyousuke[/url] is a friend of his, in the game he sometimes plays the role of Watson and helps analyzing various cases with Kyousuke.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/MISSING_PARTS_the_TANTEI_STORIES]Wikipedia[/url].]
